{"text":"ItemID: NA; Title: Standing in the Breach; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The reflective songwriting appeals to me, but I would leave it for another visit.
ItemID: NA; Title: Hypnotic Eye; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: After You Should Be So Lucky, I would choose this for its connection to Tom Petty and familiar rock sound.
ItemID: NA; Title: Shadows in the Night; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I am more interested in blues and guitar-driven rock right now than interpretations of older standards.
ItemID: NA; Title: A Fool To Care; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: I would try this because Memphis left me interested in more of Boz Scaggs's soulful blues sound.
ItemID: NA; Title: Band of Brothers; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: A country-focused album is not what I am looking for on this visit.
ItemID: NA; Title: Freedom: Atlanta Pop Festival; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: My interest in People, Hell & Angels makes live Hendrix appealing, but I would save it for later.
ItemID: NA; Title: Sons of Anarchy: Songs of Anarchy: Volume 2 Original Soundtrack; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I do not have a particular interest in the show or a soundtrack collection right now.
ItemID: NA; Title: Quiet About It: A Tribute To Jesse Winchester; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The roots-oriented songwriting sounds appealing, but I need more familiarity before choosing it.
ItemID: NA; Title: Django and Jimmie; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I am not currently seeking a traditional country collaboration.
ItemID: NA; Title: Born To Play Guitar; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The blues guitar fits my interest in Clapton and Hendrix, but I would stop after my two selections."}
